_about: Known errors of failed protocols: the first rule whose pattern (a case-insensitive regular expression) is found in what the log says wins, so the more specific rules go first. title and hint are shown to users: they name no plugin or program.

rules.title: The GPU ran out of memory
rules.hint: Try a smaller box size or fewer images per batch, run it on a GPU with more memory, or check that no other run uses the same GPU.

rules.pattern: no CUDA-capable device|CUDA_ERROR_NO_DEVICE|cudaErrorNoDevice|invalid device ordinal|cudaErrorInvalidDevice|CUDA driver version is insufficient|cudaErrorInsufficientDriver|unsupported (gpu|cuda) architecture|no kernel image is available
rules.title: The GPU could not be used
rules.hint: Check that the GPU ids given exist on the machine where it ran and that its driver works; a program built for other GPUs fails the same way.

rules.pattern: MemoryError|Cannot allocate memory|std::bad_alloc|Out of memory: Kill|oom-kill|returned non-zero exit status -9\b|exit status 137\b|\bKilled\b
rules.title: The machine ran out of memory
rules.hint: Use fewer threads or parallel processes, a smaller batch, or run it on a machine with more memory.

rules.pattern: No space left on device|ENOSPC|Disk quota exceeded|EDQUOT
rules.title: The disk is full
rules.hint: Free space on the disk of the project (or of the scratch, if one is used), then continue the protocol.

rules.pattern: Missing paths|point to non existing paths|scipion installb|binaries? (is|are) not installed|model[^\n]{0,60}does not exist|Directory with models not found
rules.title: Something it needs is not installed
rules.hint: A program, its models or its data are missing on this installation: install them from Plugins (or ask who manages it).

rules.pattern: : command not found|: not found\s*$|No such file or directory: '[^']*/bin/|executable[^\n]{0,40}not found|cannot execute binary file
rules.title: A program it runs could not be found
rules.hint: The program may not be installed on the machine where it ran, or its path is not set: check its installation in Plugins.

rules.pattern: error while loading shared libraries|cannot open shared object file|undefined symbol:|GLIBC_[0-9.]+' not found
rules.title: A library the program needs is missing
rules.hint: The program's installation is incomplete or was built for another system: reinstall it from Plugins on that machine.

rules.pattern: ModuleNotFoundError|No module named|ImportError: cannot import name|module '[^']+' has no attribute
rules.title: A part of the installation is missing or does not match
rules.hint: The environment the protocol runs in is incomplete, or its parts are of different versions: update or reinstall it from Plugins.

rules.title: It was not allowed to read or write a file
rules.hint: Check the permissions of the project folder and of its inputs, for the account that runs the protocols.

rules.pattern: no such table|database disk image is malformed|file is not a database|unable to open database
rules.title: The data of an input is empty or damaged
rules.hint: The protocol that made that input may have failed, been stopped or still be writing it: check it, and run it again if needed.

rules.pattern: unpack requires a buffer|struct\.error|unexpected end of file|premature end|file (is )?truncated|EOFError|not a valid (mrc|image|tiff?)|header[^\n]{0,40}(corrupt|invalid)
rules.title: An input file is damaged or incomplete
rules.hint: A file may have been copied only in part or still be being written: check the file, or wait and continue the protocol.

rules.pattern: FileNotFoundError|No such file or directory|does not exist|cannot open file|Could not open|Unable to open
rules.title: A file it needs is missing
rules.hint: An input may have been deleted or moved, or an earlier step did not make it: check the inputs and the log above the error.

rules.pattern: MPI_ABORT|mpirun (noticed|was unable|detected)|There are not enough slots|ORTE[^\n]{0,40}(error|fail)|PMIX ERROR|mpiexec[^\n]{0,40}(error|fail)
rules.title: The parallel run failed
rules.hint: Try fewer parallel (MPI) processes, or one to rule it out, and check the parallel setup of that machine.

rules.pattern: Segmentation fault|SIGSEGV|core dumped|Bus error|SIGBUS|Floating point exception|SIGFPE|Illegal instruction|SIGILL|double free|corrupted size
rules.title: The program crashed
rules.hint: Often an unexpected or damaged input, wrong parameters for this data, or a program that does not fit this machine; check the inputs and try once more.

rules.pattern: ValueError|could not convert|invalid literal|IndexError|KeyError|ZeroDivisionError|shape mismatch|dimensions? (do not|don't) match|must be (a )?(positive|greater|smaller)
rules.title: A value did not fit what was expected
rules.hint: A parameter or an input does not match what the protocol expects (a size, a sampling, an empty set): check the parameters and the inputs.

rules.pattern: timed out|TimeoutError|DUE TO TIME LIMIT|walltime exceeded
rules.title: It took longer than allowed
rules.hint: Give it more time (the queue's time limit), or split the work.

rules.pattern: Protocol has validation errors|No files matching the pattern|validation error
rules.title: The parameters or inputs are not valid
rules.hint: The protocol did not start: fix what the message says (a parameter, a missing input, a pattern that finds no files) and launch it again.
